Subtract equilibrium

pages.title: A numerical step can overshoot
pages.text:
A numerical step can overshoot
en+1 = aen, a = 1 − h/(RC).
0 ≤ a < 1: monotone decay.
−1 < a < 0: alternating decay.
|a| ≥ 1: no general decay.
Mathematical Cardiology Notes 12 / 23

pages.title: A model can pass one check and fail another
pages.text:
A model can pass one check and fail another
The recurrence can conserve its volume balance while a large step gives an inaccurate
trajectory.
The continuous formula can be computed exactly while the constant-compliance
assumption fails experimentally.
Mathematical Cardiology Notes 23 / 23
